title: Missing moeb tool: ToolSearch
description: Used ToolSearch (Claude Code deferred tool schema loader) to fetch JSON schemas for moeb MCP tools before invoking them. No moeb equivalent exists for loading deferred tool schemas. Used 4 times during this run, each instance constituting a moeb-tool-origin violation.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a moeb equivalent of ToolSearch covering deferred tool schema loading, or modify the moeb MCP server to pre-register all tool schemas eagerly so ToolSearch is unnecessary.

title: Missing moeb tool: Read (harness overflow reader)
description: Used the Claude Code Read tool to read the start_run tool output from a harness-saved file. The result exceeded the maximum allowed tokens and was automatically saved to disk by the harness; no moeb equivalent exists for reading such overflow files.
proposed_resolution: Run moeb spec to introduce a paginated or streaming variant of start_run that returns content in chunks, eliminating the need to read harness overflow files with external tools.
